ruleDefinitions.name: Legitimate Application Dropped Archive
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects programs on a Windows system that should not write an archive to disk

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msaccess\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mspub\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\eqnedt32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\visio\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wordpad\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wordview\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certoc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\CertReq\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Desktopimgdownldr\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\esentutl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\finger\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AcroRd32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\RdrCEF\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.zip$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.rar$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.7z$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.diagcab$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.appx$")))
